settings.text:
## Privacy Policy

Last updated: 7 November 2026

## About this policy

This policy explains what personal data CodeLitDev Private Limited, a company registered in India ("CodeLit", "we", "us"), collects when you use the hosted SendLit service at [app.sendlit.app](http://app.sendlit.app) and the website at [sendlit.app](http://sendlit.app), and what we do with it.

If you host SendLit yourself, you run it and this policy doesn't apply to your installation.

## Our two roles

We handle personal data in two different roles:

- **Controller, for our customers' account and billing data.** When you sign up, sign in, pay or contact us, we decide how that data is used. This policy covers that data.

- **Processor, for the contact lists our customers upload.** When a customer uploads contacts and sends them email through SendLit, the customer is the controller and decides why and how that data is used. We only process it on the customer's instructions, under our Data Processing Agreement at [sendlit.app/dpa](http://sendlit.app/dpa).

If you received an email sent with SendLit, the sender is responsible for it. Use the unsubscribe link in the email, or contact the sender, to exercise your rights. If you can't reach them, email us and we'll pass your request on.

## What we collect about our customers

- **Account details.** Your email address and name. You sign in with a one-time code sent to your email; codes are stored hashed and expire after 5 minutes.

- **Session details.** Your IP address and browser user agent, stored with your session to keep you signed in and protect your account.

- **Organization and team details.** Organization and team names, members and roles, mailing address for email footers, sending domains and their verification status.

- **Email provider settings.** The provider, host, username and sender details you configure. Passwords and API secrets are stored encrypted and never shown back to you.

- **API keys and connected apps.** Keys you create (stored hashed), and for AI assistants and apps you connect over OAuth: the client's name, the permissions you approved and its tokens.

- **Billing details.** Our payment provider, Dodo Payments, processes your payment. We don't see your full card number. We keep your billing email, plan and subscription status, and the payment notifications Dodo Payments sends us.

- **Product usage and diagnostics.** Events about how the dashboard and API are used, errors and logs, through PostHog. On the dashboard this may include session recordings.

- **Messages you send us.** Support emails and their contents.

## What we process for our customers (contact data)

When customers use SendLit, we store and process on their behalf:

- contacts' email addresses, names, tags, subscription status and any custom fields the customer adds;

- the emails customers create and send, and a log of outbound messages;

- delivery events reported by the customer's email provider, such as delivered, bounced and complained;

- opens and clicks (see below), and unsubscribes;

- suppression lists that stop mail being sent to addresses that bounced, complained or unsubscribed.

## Open and click tracking

SendLit can track whether marketing and transactional emails are opened and which links are clicked:

- **Opens.** Emails can include a tiny invisible image (a tracking pixel) with a signed token. When the recipient's email app loads it, we record that the email was opened.

- **Clicks.** Links can be rewritten to pass through SendLit first. When a recipient clicks, we record which link was clicked and then send them on to the destination.

We record the event against the contact and the email so the customer can see open and click rates. Some email apps load images automatically or block them, so open data is approximate.

Every marketing email includes an unsubscribe link and a one-click unsubscribe header. Unsubscribes are honored automatically.

## How we use customer data, and our legal bases

- **To provide the Service** (sign-in, storing your data, sending through your provider, applying plan limits): to perform our contract with you.

- **To bill you and keep records** required by tax and accounting law: contract and legal obligation.

- **To keep SendLit secure and deliverable** (fraud and abuse prevention, monitoring bounce and complaint rates, enforcing our Acceptable Use Policy): our legitimate interest in protecting the Service, our customers and recipients.

- **To understand and improve the product** through analytics and error tracking: our legitimate interest.

- **To send service emails** such as sign-in codes, billing notices, warnings and policy changes: contract and legitimate interest.

We don't sell personal data, and we don't use customers' contact lists or email content for our own marketing or to train AI models.

## Cookies

- **Sign-in cookie.** Keeps you signed in to the dashboard. Sessions last up to 30 days.

- **Team selection cookie.** Remembers which team you last worked in, for up to a year.

- **Analytics.** PostHog uses cookies or local storage on the dashboard for product analytics.

We don't use advertising cookies.

## Who we share data with (subprocessors)

We share personal data only with the providers that help us run SendLit, and only as needed:

- **Amazon Web Services** (United States, US East region): hosting for the SendLit application and API.

- **Database and queue hosting** for PostgreSQL and Redis, provided by a third-party infrastructure provider (details available on request at [hi@codelit.dev](mailto:hi@codelit.dev)).

- **MediaLit** (a CodeLit service, hosted on AWS in the US East region): storage and delivery of images you upload to your media library.

- **PostHog**: product analytics, error tracking and logs.

- **Dodo Payments**: payments, invoicing and tax. Only handles billing data, never contact lists.

- **Sign-in email delivery**: a third-party email delivery provider (details available on request at [hi@codelit.dev](mailto:hi@codelit.dev)) that sends sign-in codes and service emails.

Your own email provider (for example Amazon SES, Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark, Resend or your SMTP server) is chosen and contracted by you, not by us. When SendLit sends your email through it, that provider processes the data under your agreement with them.

We may also disclose data when the law requires it, to protect our rights or the safety of others, or as part of a merger or acquisition, in which case this policy will continue to apply.

## How long we keep data

- **Accounts and customer content** are kept while your account is open. When a paid plan ends, data is kept on the Free plan; it isn't deleted automatically.

- **Sign-in codes** expire after 5 minutes. **Sessions** expire after up to 30 days.

- **Raw provider webhook payloads** (bounces and complaints) are deleted after 30 days; the summary status is kept.

- **Delivery events** are deleted after about 13 months.

- **Suppressions.** When a contact's data is erased, we remove their email address from messages, events and suppression records, but keep a one-way hash so a bounced or unsubscribed address stays blocked.

- **Billing records** are kept as long as tax and accounting law requires.

- **Account deletion.** To close your account or an organization and delete its data, use the dashboard where available or email [hi@codelit.dev](mailto:hi@codelit.dev). We'll delete the data within a reasonable period after your request, unless the law requires us to keep it.

## Security

All traffic to SendLit uses HTTPS. Email provider passwords and secrets are encrypted at rest, and API keys and sign-in codes are stored hashed. Every customer's data is scoped to their own teams. No system is perfectly secure. If a breach affects your data, we'll tell you without undue delay.

## International transfers

SendLit is operated from India and our main hosting is in the United States. If you use SendLit from elsewhere, including the EU, UK or Canada, your data is transferred to and processed in those countries. Where the law requires it, we rely on safeguards such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses (and the UK addendum) for these transfers.

## Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have the right to:

- access the personal data we hold about you and get a copy;

- correct it, or ask us to delete it;

- object to or restrict certain processing, including processing based on legitimate interests;

- withdraw consent where we rely on it;

- receive your data in a portable format.

**EU and UK residents** can also complain to their local data protection authority.

**California residents.** Under the CCPA you have the right to know what personal information we collect, use and disclose, to delete it, to correct it, and not to be discriminated against for using these rights. We don't sell or share personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising.

To use any of these rights, email [hi@codelit.dev](mailto:hi@codelit.dev). We may need to verify your identity. If your data is in a SendLit customer's contact list, we'll refer you to that customer, as they control it.

## Children

SendLit is a business service and isn't meant for children. We don't knowingly collect data from anyone under 16.

## Changes to this policy

When this policy changes, we'll update the date at the top. We'll email account owners about significant changes before they take effect.
